line: Pick up one piece of litter you didn't drop.
paragraph: Paul and Ruth Richmond-Watson are married, and they scrub street signs together. They started in September, when they wanted a new hobby they could share. Both are autistic with ADHD. They dream of traveling across the country to make every sign spotless. One sign at a time, they are already on their way.
